name: @frontierengineer/link-client
description: Auditable, multi-uplink secure-connection client for the Link relay model: Noise (NKpsk0) sealed channel + SPAKE2 (RFC 9382) short-code pairing, end-to-end encrypted over content-blind relays.

scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test test/secureChannel.test.ts test/pairing.test.ts test/hardening.test.ts test/registerAuth.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
